signers.label: Signing Party (Party One or Party Two)
signers.note: The 'signing_party' choice field selects which already-collected name (party_one_name or party_two_name) this refers to — route the handoff to that person.

signers.label: Counsel
signers.note: Only applicable if counsel_name was provided.

signers.label: Court Authority
signers.note: Filled automatically at approval — not part of the intake handoff flow.

fields.label: Party One
fields.prompt: What is Party One's full name?

fields.label: Party Two
fields.prompt: What is Party Two's full name?

fields.label: Counsel
fields.prompt: Who is representing counsel for this divorce (or answer "None")?

fields.label: Specific Requests
fields.prompt: Are there any specific requests to be documented? (or answer "None")

fields.label: Either Party (Selection)
fields.prompt: Which party is signing to enact this dissolution — Party One or Party Two?
fields.note: Selects which already-collected name (party_one_name or party_two_name) becomes the signing_party_signature. Not displayed on the document itself.

fields.label: Either Party (Signing)
fields.note: Value is whichever of party_one_name/party_two_name matches the 'signing_party' selection, confirmed by that person directly.

fields.label: Counsel Signature
fields.note: Collected from counsel directly. Only applicable if counsel_name was provided.

fields.label: Court Authority
fields.note: Rendered in cursive. Filled in by the bot when a judge finalizes the dissolution — never asked of the applicants. Also used for the identifying 'Court Authority' name row.
